_: The feature feed: newest first. scripts/make-update.js embeds it in the signed update.json; the console shows a NEW badge for entries newer than the version last looked at. Edit on the website's manage.html (Release manager) or by hand, then run node scripts/make-update.js.

features.title: Release 1.23.0.1 stable
items: ACOUSTICS page: log sine sweep and stepped sine (amplitude, phase, THD, THD+N), RTA to 1/48 octave with RMS averaging and level alignment, impulse response, ETC, RT60 / Topt, delay compensation, waterfall, spectrogram, room simulator, auto EQ with target curves (20 - 400 Hz) set on a strip or exported as REW / miniDSP text and JSON, mic calibration files, SPL offset, offline sweep WAV
360 AUDIO: binaural placement of every strip for headphones (azimuth, elevation, distance, spread), also in the SDK (API v4)
RTA EQ has its own EQ rack on the master (PROGRAM EQ); TONE (EQ) stays the microphone channel EQ
MASTERING plug-in after the program EQ: low and air shelves, glue compressor, saturation, output into the limiter, six presets

Input / output detection names what is connected (headphones, headset, speakers, microphone, audio interface, Bluetooth, digital out) on ASIO, WASAPI and DirectSound, shows it in the header, and always pairs an input with the output so every channel meters in real time
5.0 surround in the SDK (API v3): per-strip DEPTH, amix_mixer_process5
Plug-in slots: 10 on BASIC, unlimited on PRO, STUDIO and MASTER
Every console text follows the language menu: 21 languages with full interface tables
WHAT'S NEW feed with a NEW badge in the header, managed from the website's release manager
Windows: the colours load correctly (the theme was missing in the Windows build), drop-downs follow the theme, the update check has its TLS plug-in
